svg.title: Atlas-20 daily processing order
svg.desc: Fixed daily-bar accounting sequence for the fictional scenario. Orders and cash reservations are frozen at the prior close. Batch processing of a close exit before an opening entry is an accounting order only; no later proceeds fund that entry or increase its quantity.
svg.text: 1. Carry in the frozen state
Rule sheet v1.0, holdings with their stops, targets and holding-session counts, orders placed at the previous
close, and reserved cash.
2. Process held positions
No bar: mark stale and keep the slot. Otherwise apply the exit priority: gap at the open, both levels in one bar
(stop first), stop, target, then the time exit at the close.
3. Process entry orders
Open at or below the limit fills at the open; a trade below the limit fills at the limit; a touch or a higher low
cancels. Cap shares at 1% of volume and release every reservation.
4. Mark the close
Equity = cash + shares × close (halted: last valid close). Check that cash flows reconcile to the cent.
5. Screen
Skip held stocks. Then check the complete 21-bar record, the signal, the price band, liquidity, and the earnings
window, recording the first failure.
6. Rank, size, reserve
Sort by breakout margin, then name. Free slots = 5 − open positions. Shares = the smallest of the risk, notional,
and cash allowances; reserve shares × limit + $2.50.
7. Log and review
Record orders, rejections, skips, and any review trigger before the next open. A trigger starts a review; it
does not change the rules.
